creatures.name: Mirror snails
creatures.desc: Tiny aberrant creature. Reflect nearby scenes on their shells with small, unsettling differences.

creatures.name: Drift polyps
creatures.desc: Tiny aberrant creature. Translucent colonies pulse with light and numb whatever brushes them.

creatures.name: Tally wasps
creatures.desc: Tiny aberrant creature. Count and mark every creature that passes their nest.

creatures.name: Blink hares
creatures.desc: Small aberrant creature. Vanish and reappear a few paces away, leading dogs off cliffs.

creatures.name: Gutter tongues
creatures.desc: Small aberrant creature. Prehensile lurkers in drains and wells grasp at ankles and buckets.

creatures.name: Eyeless owls
creatures.desc: Small aberrant creature. Hunt by senses no one can name and leave prey unable to remember the attack.

creatures.name: Knuckle crabs
creatures.desc: Small aberrant creature. Assembled from too many joints, scuttle the tideline and pinch off fingers.

creatures.name: Stitch wolves
creatures.desc: Medium aberrant creature. Packs that share one body's wounds and heal by taking flesh from others.

creatures.name: Cellar mouths
creatures.desc: Medium aberrant creature. Grow inside abandoned buildings as rooms that digest visitors.

creatures.name: Hollow deer
creatures.desc: Large aberrant creature. Empty-skinned grazers move in perfect unison and swallow whole what they surround.

creatures.name: Wandering geometries
creatures.desc: Large aberrant creature. Impossible shapes drift over the ground and fold the space they cross.

creatures.name: Dust hoppers
creatures.desc: Tiny fantastic beast. Desert grasshoppers that shed a choking chalk when startled.

creatures.name: Ember newts
creatures.desc: Tiny fantastic beast. Glow in warm springs and singe the fingers that try to catch them.

creatures.name: Glow snails
creatures.desc: Tiny fantastic beast. Light forest floors at night and leave luminous trails to their feeding grounds.

creatures.name: Tinder mice
creatures.desc: Tiny fantastic beast. Nest in dry thatch and spark small fires when they quarrel.

creatures.name: Mirror finches
creatures.desc: Small fantastic beast. Repeat any call they hear and lead hunters in circles.

creatures.name: Silver salmon
creatures.desc: Small fantastic beast. Fish whose scales hold moonlight, fought over by every fisher upriver.

creatures.name: Ridge goats
creatures.desc: Small fantastic beast. Climb sheer cliffs on sticky hooves and knock loose stones onto climbers.

creatures.name: Thorn boars
creatures.desc: Small fantastic beast. Bristle-backed pigs that charge from hedgerows and leave barbs in the wound.

creatures.name: Dune hounds
creatures.desc: Small fantastic beast. Pale pack dogs run down travelers who stray from the caravan wells.

creatures.name: Giant beetles
creatures.desc: Medium fantastic beast. Armored beetles the size of hounds undermine granaries and gnaw timber.

creatures.name: Sky rays
creatures.desc: Medium fantastic beast. Glide on mountain updrafts and snatch lambs from high pastures.

creatures.name: Giant bats
creatures.desc: Medium fantastic beast. Roost in cave mouths and hunt across the fields at dusk.

creatures.name: Frost owls
creatures.desc: Small fantastic beast. Silent white hunters whose wingbeats freeze the breath of their prey.

creatures.name: Giant leeches
creatures.desc: Medium fantastic beast. Drain wading cattle in the reed beds.

creatures.name: Giant eagles
creatures.desc: Large fantastic beast. Nest on high crags and carry off goats, dogs and the occasional shepherd.

creatures.name: Burrow hulks
creatures.desc: Large fantastic beast. Armored diggers surface beneath herds and drag them under.

creatures.name: Giant centipedes
creatures.desc: Large fantastic beast. Hunt in damp ruins and cave mouths with a venom that stops the heart.

creatures.name: Reef stalkers
creatures.desc: Large fantastic beast. Camouflaged hunters lie along reef walls and take divers and dolphins alike.

creatures.name: Woolly mammoths
creatures.desc: Huge fantastic beast. Tusked grazing herds trample the tundra and gore hunters who come too close.

creatures.name: Cave bears
creatures.desc: Large fantastic beast. Enormous bears den in mountain caves and hold whole valleys as their range.

creatures.name: Phoenixes
creatures.desc: Large fantastic beast. Fire-birds nest on volcanic peaks and burn the slopes around their eyries.

creatures.name: Behemoths
creatures.desc: Colossal fantastic beast. Mountain-shouldered grazers flatten forests and cannot be turned by any wall.

creatures.name: Scale mites
creatures.desc: Tiny draconic creature. Infest dragon roosts and spread to any stable warm enough.

creatures.name: Ember geckos
creatures.desc: Tiny draconic creature. Warm-blooded lizards nest in chimneys and hoard bright pebbles.

creatures.name: Glass-wing dragonets
creatures.desc: Small draconic creature. Hover over flowering meadows and snap at bees and birds.

creatures.name: Cliff drakes
creatures.desc: Small draconic creature. Nest in cliff crevices and dive on climbers and goats.

creatures.name: Ash drakes
creatures.desc: Small draconic creature. Bask on cooling lava and hiss sparks at intruders.

creatures.name: Snow drakes
creatures.desc: Small draconic creature. Burrow through drifts and ambush from beneath the snow.

creatures.name: Tide drakes
creatures.desc: Small draconic creature. Hunt the shallows in packs and steal from fishing nets.

creatures.name: Thicket drakes
creatures.desc: Small draconic creature. Hedge-dwelling hunters that take lambs and hens from the field edge.

creatures.name: Ridge drakes
creatures.desc: Medium draconic creature. Wingless climbers hold the passes and roll stones onto travelers.

creatures.name: Bog wyrmlings
creatures.desc: Medium draconic creature. Young marsh dragons hunt from flooded reed beds before claiming a domain.

creatures.name: Spire drakes
creatures.desc: Medium draconic creature. Roost on ruined towers and contest the air with griffons.

creatures.name: Salt drakes
creatures.desc: Medium draconic creature. Salt-crusted coastal hunters raid seal colonies and beached wrecks.

creatures.name: Iron drakes
creatures.desc: Large draconic creature. Ore-eating hunters lair in mine shafts and drive off the miners.

creatures.name: Spark motes
creatures.desc: Tiny primordial creature. Drift as living static over storm-touched hills.

creatures.name: Dew sprites
creatures.desc: Tiny primordial creature. Condense on meadows at dawn and vanish when trodden.

creatures.name: Silt wisps
creatures.desc: Tiny primordial creature. Cloud the shallows and nip at the toes of waders.

creatures.name: Frost sprites
creatures.desc: Tiny primordial creature. Rime the eaves and nip exposed skin on still nights.

creatures.name: Cinder hoppers
creatures.desc: Small primordial creature. Leap from vent to vent and scorch the grass between.

creatures.name: Clay hounds
creatures.desc: Small primordial creature. Shaped from river mud, chase anything that crosses their bank.

creatures.name: Gust foxes
creatures.desc: Small primordial creature. Ride the wind across open steppe and unseat riders in sudden squalls.

creatures.name: Brine sprites
creatures.desc: Small primordial creature. Ride the tide line and foul fresh water carried on boats.

creatures.name: Moss golems
creatures.desc: Medium primordial creature. Slow guardians of old groves that crush what breaks the trees.

creatures.name: Geyser serpents
creatures.desc: Medium primordial creature. Rise with the scalding water and strike anything at the pool's edge.

creatures.name: Hail wolves
creatures.desc: Medium primordial creature. Packs run inside blizzards and leave frozen prey behind.

creatures.name: Sandstone stalkers
creatures.desc: Medium primordial creature. Rock-skinned hunters wait motionless among desert outcrops.

creatures.name: Kelp wardens
creatures.desc: Large primordial creature. Woven from living kelp, entangle boats and divers in the forests below.

creatures.name: Hedge sprites
creatures.desc: Tiny fey creature. Tangle the hair and bootlaces of anyone who sleeps under their hedge.

creatures.name: Moss hares
creatures.desc: Small fey creature. Green-furred and shy, they lead children deeper into the wood.

creatures.name: Acorn folk
creatures.desc: Small fey creature. Tiny oak-dwelling people pelt intruders with hard fruit.

creatures.name: Hob cats
creatures.desc: Small fey creature. Sleek shapeshifting cats trade favors for cream and secrets.

creatures.name: Brownies
creatures.desc: Small fey creature. Do chores for households that leave offerings and wreck those that forget.

creatures.name: Will-o'-wisps
creatures.desc: Tiny fey creature. Marsh lights lure travelers into deep water.

creatures.name: Toadstool imps
creatures.desc: Small fey creature. Sprout from fairy rings and spoil milk and memory alike.

creatures.name: Bramble hounds
creatures.desc: Small fey creature. Thorn-coated dogs hunt poachers through the undergrowth.

creatures.name: Spriggans
creatures.desc: Medium fey creature. Guardians of buried treasure who swell to giant size when robbed.

creatures.name: Fauns
creatures.desc: Medium fey creature. Pipe-playing goat folk draw revelers into dances that last for days.

creatures.name: Selkies
creatures.desc: Medium fey creature. Seal-folk haul out on remote beaches and bargain over stolen skins.

creatures.name: Leshy
creatures.desc: Large fey creature. Forest lords lead woodcutters astray and swap the paths behind them.

creatures.name: Green knights
creatures.desc: Large fey creature. Challenge travelers at fords and take heads from those who refuse.

creatures.name: Thorn stags
creatures.desc: Large fey creature. Antlered with living bramble, charge riders who cross the court's meadows.

creatures.name: Drowned lanterns
creatures.desc: Tiny undead creature. Corpse-lights drift above wreck fields and draw salvagers onto the rocks.

creatures.name: Barnacle dead
creatures.desc: Small undead creature. Shell-crusted drowned sailors crawl the shallows and cling to passing hulls.

creatures.name: Sulphur eels
creatures.desc: Small infernal creature. Nest around undersea vents and scald the nets that pass over them.

creatures.name: Beacon jellies
creatures.desc: Tiny holy creature. Glow beneath safe channels and dim over reefs and wrecks.

creatures.name: Bilge worms
creatures.desc: Tiny unholy creature. Breed in befouled holds and spread rot from hull to hull across a harbor.

creatures.name: Eyestalk shoals
creatures.desc: Small aberrant creature. Schools of watching stalks turn as one to follow passing boats.

creatures.name: Glass shrimp
creatures.desc: Tiny fantastic beast. Near-invisible swarms strip bait from lines and nets.

creatures.name: Bladefish
creatures.desc: Small fantastic beast. Fin-edged shoals slash the legs of waders and swimmers.

creatures.name: Moon carp
creatures.desc: Small fantastic beast. Pale pond fish that surface on bright nights and are said to grant small wishes.

creatures.name: Pond dragonets
creatures.desc: Small draconic creature. Newt-sized dragonets bask on lily pads and snap at dragonflies.

creatures.name: Foam sprites
creatures.desc: Tiny primordial creature. Ride the surf line and hiss in the wake of boats.

creatures.name: Pond sprites
creatures.desc: Tiny fey creature. Tangle fishing lines or mend nets, depending on their mood.

creatures.name: Wreck merrows
creatures.desc: Small fey creature. Sly sea-folk trade wreck salvage for songs and secrets.

creatures.name: Lantern jellies
creatures.desc: Tiny fantastic beast. Drift in glowing swarms that mark the tide's turn and sting bare skin.

creatures.name: Wreck crabs
creatures.desc: Small fantastic beast. Scuttle over sunken hulls and strip the drowned of buckles and rings.

creatures.name: Singing shoals
creatures.desc: Tiny fantastic beast. Silver fish whose massed chorus carries through hulls on still nights.

creatures.name: Anchor eels
creatures.desc: Medium fantastic beast. Coil around anchor lines and moorings and pull swimmers under.

creatures.name: Snapping pike
creatures.desc: Medium fantastic beast. Log-length pike that take ducks, dogs and the hands of fishermen.

creatures.name: Brown rat
creatures.desc: A burrowing rat that thrives around granaries, docks and middens and breeds all year.

creatures.name: Black rat
creatures.desc: A climbing rat that nests in roofs, ships and warehouses.

creatures.name: House mouse
creatures.desc: A small mouse that lives inside walls and stores wherever people keep grain.

creatures.name: Bank vole
creatures.desc: A rusty-backed vole of hedgerows and woodland floors.

creatures.name: Common shrew
creatures.desc: A tiny, restless insect-eater that hunts through leaf litter day and night.

creatures.name: Eastern chipmunk
creatures.desc: A striped ground squirrel that hoards nuts in burrows under stone walls.

creatures.name: Groundhog
creatures.desc: A heavy burrowing marmot of field edges that sleeps through winter.

creatures.name: Eastern gray squirrel
creatures.desc: A bushy-tailed tree squirrel of parks and broadleaf woods that buries acorns.

creatures.name: Eastern cottontail
creatures.desc: A short-eared rabbit of brush and field edges that freezes, then bolts.

creatures.name: Virginia opossum
creatures.desc: A nocturnal marsupial that raids bins and nests and plays dead when caught.

creatures.name: Common brushtail possum
creatures.desc: A tree-dwelling marsupial that dens in hollows and roofs and strips garden fruit.

creatures.name: European wildcat
creatures.desc: A stocky striped cat that hunts rodents along woodland edges.

creatures.name: Feral cat
creatures.desc: A free-living domestic cat that hunts birds and rodents around farms and towns.

creatures.name: Serval
creatures.desc: A long-legged spotted cat that leaps on rodents in tall savanna grass.

creatures.name: Bobcat
creatures.desc: A tufted-eared cat of scrub and rocky woodland that takes rabbits and fawns.

creatures.name: Cougar
creatures.desc: A lean mountain lion that stalks deer through canyons and forested slopes.

creatures.name: Leopard
creatures.desc: A spotted cat that hauls kills into trees and hunts anything from rats to antelope.

creatures.name: Clouded leopard
creatures.desc: A long-tailed forest cat that hunts monkeys and deer from the canopy.

creatures.name: Dingo
creatures.desc: A wild dog of dry scrub and plains that hunts alone or in small family groups.

creatures.name: Feral dog
creatures.desc: A loose pack of ownerless dogs that scavenges settlement edges and worries livestock.

creatures.name: Raccoon dog
creatures.desc: A short-legged canid of wet woodland that eats frogs, fruit and carrion.

creatures.name: Maned wolf
creatures.desc: A tall, solitary red canid of open grassland that hunts rodents and fruit.

creatures.name: Bat-eared fox
creatures.desc: A small savanna fox that listens for termites with enormous ears.

creatures.name: Striped skunk
creatures.desc: A black-and-white forager that digs for grubs and sprays when cornered.

creatures.name: Least weasel
creatures.desc: A tiny slender hunter that follows voles down their own tunnels.

creatures.name: Stoat
creatures.desc: A white-in-winter weasel that kills rabbits larger than itself.

creatures.name: European polecat
creatures.desc: A dark musky mustelid of hedgerows and barns that hunts rats and frogs.

creatures.name: Banded mongoose
creatures.desc: A social mongoose that forages in noisy troops for beetles and eggs.

creatures.name: Meerkat
creatures.desc: A sentry-posting mongoose of dry plains that lives in large burrow colonies.

creatures.name: Common genet
creatures.desc: A spotted, cat-like hunter of rocky scrub that takes rodents and birds at night.

creatures.name: White-nosed coati
creatures.desc: A ring-tailed forager that travels in bands and digs for grubs and fruit.

creatures.name: Giant anteater
creatures.desc: A long-snouted grassland forager that rips open termite mounds and defends itself with its claws.

creatures.name: Ground pangolin
creatures.desc: A scaled, ant-eating mammal that rolls into an armored ball.

creatures.name: Aardvark
creatures.desc: A nocturnal burrower that digs out termite mounds across the savanna.

creatures.name: Common warthog
creatures.desc: A tusked savanna pig that grazes on its knees and backs into burrows.

creatures.name: Red river hog
creatures.desc: A bristly forest pig that roots along rivers in family groups.

creatures.name: Koala
creatures.desc: A slow tree-dwelling marsupial that eats only eucalyptus leaves.

creatures.name: Common wombat
creatures.desc: A stout burrowing marsupial that grazes at night and blocks its tunnel with its rump.

creatures.name: Red kangaroo
creatures.desc: A tall hopping grazer of dry plains that boxes and kicks when cornered.

creatures.name: Red-necked wallaby
creatures.desc: A small hopping grazer of scrub and forest edge.

creatures.name: Giant panda
creatures.desc: A black-and-white bear of mountain bamboo forest that feeds for most of the day.

creatures.name: Red panda
creatures.desc: A rust-colored tree-dweller of cool mountain forest that eats bamboo and berries.

creatures.name: Sloth bear
creatures.desc: A shaggy forest bear that sucks up termites and charges when surprised.

creatures.name: Sun bear
creatures.desc: A small rainforest bear that climbs for honey and fruit.

creatures.name: Spectacled bear
creatures.desc: A cloud-forest bear that builds feeding platforms in trees.

creatures.name: Rhesus macaque
creatures.desc: A bold troop monkey that raids fields and temples and bites when crowded.

creatures.name: Olive baboon
creatures.desc: A large ground-dwelling monkey that moves in big troops and mobs predators.

creatures.name: White-faced capuchin
creatures.desc: A clever forest monkey that uses stones to crack nuts and steals from camps.

creatures.name: Ring-tailed lemur
creatures.desc: A striped-tailed primate of dry forest that sunbathes in troops.

creatures.name: Hanuman langur
creatures.desc: A gray leaf-eating monkey that lives around villages and temples in large troops.

creatures.name: Gibbon
creatures.desc: A long-armed singing ape that swings through the high canopy in pairs.

creatures.name: Fallow deer
creatures.desc: A spotted parkland deer that grazes in herds at woodland edges.

creatures.name: White-tailed deer
creatures.desc: A common woodland deer that browses field margins and flags its tail when alarmed.

creatures.name: Elk
creatures.desc: A large bugling deer of mountain meadows whose bulls fight in autumn.

creatures.name: Sika deer
creatures.desc: A spotted forest deer that whistles when alarmed.

creatures.name: Mouflon
creatures.desc: A wild sheep of rocky hills with curled horns.

creatures.name: Markhor
creatures.desc: A corkscrew-horned wild goat of high crags.

creatures.name: Dromedary camel
creatures.desc: A one-humped desert camel that ranges between wells and browses thorn scrub.

creatures.name: Guanaco
creatures.desc: A wild llama of high dry plains that spits and lives in family herds.

creatures.name: Onager
creatures.desc: A wild ass of desert steppe that runs in small herds.

creatures.name: Okapi
creatures.desc: A striped-legged forest giraffe that browses alone in deep rainforest.

creatures.name: Asian elephant
creatures.desc: A forest elephant that moves in small herds and flattens crops on its routes.

creatures.name: Black rhinoceros
creatures.desc: A hook-lipped browsing rhino of thorn scrub with a short temper.

creatures.name: Indian rhinoceros
creatures.desc: An armored one-horned rhino of tall wet grassland.

creatures.name: Water buffalo
creatures.desc: A heavy wetland bovine that wallows in mud and charges when its herd is threatened.

creatures.name: Gaur
creatures.desc: A massive forest bison of hill country that grazes in herds.
